Your energy, your way

An early start, a demanding work block, a day that will not slow down. NeuroFuel Kit brings ARK Drops and ARK Melts together so you can choose the flavours and strengths that suit your routine. Drops bring the caffeine-free cooling reset; Melts add a measured caffeine option when you want it.

Choose your perfect pair

Choose 1 Kit for one Drops bottle and one Melts pack, or 2 Kits for two of each. Pick Original or Lemon Ice Drops and Original or Extra Strong Melts; the two-kit option repeats your chosen pair. Want to try everything? One of Each includes both Drops flavours and both Melts strengths.

Keep each serving simple

Drops use a 0.25 ml serving, with a 0.5 ml daily dose. Melts dissolve on your tongue, with 30 in every pack. Both formats are small enough to keep in your bag, so you can build a routine that travels with you, without a shaker or a coffee stop.

Know your strength

Drops are caffeine-free. Original Melts contain 50 mg caffeine, 50 mg L-theanine and 100 mcg B12 per melt. Extra Strong contains 100 mg caffeine, 60 mg L-theanine and 100 mcg B12. Choose the combination you prefer and see every bottle and pack in your kit before you buy.
